title: Fundamental solution expansions in stochastic homogenization of parabolic systems with time-dependent coefficients
summary: This paper studies fundamental solutions of uniformly parabolic systems with stationary random coefficients depending on space and time. Under ergodicity and local regularity, we establish quenched Gaussian bounds for the kernel and its spatial derivatives, with stationary random prefactors. A spectral gap assumption gives moments of every finite order for these prefactors and hence annealed Gaussian bounds.
